From the audit lens, this declaration is fully verifiable from git history alone. Committing the real-shape corpus of at least five families and input encodings prior to the red slice guarantees that every accepted spelling variant, reference change, and regression check is permanently preserved in the commit graph. Requiring exact models and services to be pinned and recorded before any seat runs closes loopholes around unrecorded environment drift or invisible seat substitutions. The separation of the adversarial review and sign-off seats, coupled with committing measurements against the test project, ensures compliance with standing practices without relying on transient session state.
